action_summary: Remove pre-CV topic downsampling, SMOTE, mean imputation, and inverse-class weighting to restore the natural training distribution after the documented regression. Repair floating-point OOF storage and identifier alignment; generate live test features instead of merging a static public-test cache, retaining only reproducible ranked features and transformer stacking outputs. Keep the established LightGBM ensemble, derive QWK objective moments from the real labels, and adopt bounded ordinal cutpoints only when cross-fitted calibration improves QWK. No training or inference was run; leaderboard improvement remains unmeasured.
